title: Support Ticket Filter
description: Build a filterable support ticket list with search, priority filter, and statistics. Practice the interview pattern of building interactive list UIs.
requirements: Display a list of support tickets with title, priority (high/medium/low), and status (open/closed)
Add a search input that filters tickets by title (case-insensitive)
Add filter buttons for priority: All, High, Medium, Low
Show a count: 'Showing X of Y tickets'
Show additional stat: 'Z open tickets' (count of open tickets in filtered results)
Use controlled components for all inputs
Each ticket in the list should show: title, priority, and status

browserTests.name: Ticket list displays all tickets initially
